MAST.source: sol_half: each of the 656 solenoid elements carries half of magnetics_sol_current (the feed current), the solenoid being wound two-in-hand (two parallel conductors per turn, 328 turns; the MAST Upgrade solenoid is documented as 324 turns two-in-hand in four layers); Berkery et al. (2021) give a solenoid current of +22 to -17 kA against a dataset feed current of about +-46 kA; the flux-swing and flux-consumption checks are in reports/coil_flux/mast_solenoid_check.md (2026-10-15). P-coils as stored, no flat term. Set from the hardware, not fitted.
